in_sanskrit.name: कन्हा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gives relief from all sufferings, the one who is beyond all sorrows.

in_hindi.name: कन्हा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has waning energy or enthusiasm, or the one who gives relief from all sufferings.

in_tamil.name: கன்ஹா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has come to an end, or the one who has come to an end of all his suffering.

in_telugu.name: కన్హా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is free from all troubles or sorrows.

in_marathi.name: Kanha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kanha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Kansh', which means 'ability to bear'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is referred to as Kanha. He is considered the eighth avatar of Lord Vishnu and is known for his mischievous nature and divine love for Radha and his devotees. Kanha is a symbol of power, love, and protection.
